nodes.title: Why Choose ZX Bank Fixed Deposits?
nodes.summary: Reasons to choose ZX Bank FDs: competitive interest rates that beat regular savings accounts, flexible tenures ranging from 7 days to 10 years, safety backed by regulatory compliance, instant overdrafts or loans up to 90% of the FD value, premature withdrawal availability, and instant digital opening via the app or NetBanking.

nodes.title: Features & Benefits
nodes.summary: FD features and benefits: minimum deposits vary by country (₹5,000 India, LKR 10,000 Sri Lanka, BDT 10,000 Bangladesh, BTN 1,000 Bhutan, NPR 1,500 Nepal); payout monthly, quarterly, or on maturity; special schemes include senior citizen extra interest, tax-saver FDs, and recurring deposits; joint holding with nomination and auto-renewal are offered.

nodes.title: Available In
nodes.summary: Fixed deposits are available in India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, and Nepal, with both branch booking and online/digital booking offered in every country.

nodes.title: How to Apply
nodes.summary: FD can be opened three ways: via the ZX Bank Asia mobile app (choose Fixed Deposit, set amount/tenure/nominee, confirm with OTP or biometrics), via NetBanking (Deposits to Open Fixed Deposit), or at a branch with KYC documents and a completed application form.

nodes.title: Sample Interest Rates* (for illustrative purposes)
nodes.summary: Illustrative sample FD interest rates by tenure: 3.50% regular/4.00% senior citizen for 7-45 days, 4.25%/4.75% for 46-180 days, 5.75%/6.25% for 181 days to 1 year, 6.20%/6.70% for 1-3 years, and 6.30%/6.80% for 3-5 years; rates are subject to change.

nodes.title: ESG & CSR Initiatives
nodes.summary: Part of the deposits fund green finance projects such as Bhutanese hydropower and Nepalese solar ventures, so savings contribute to a sustainable future.

nodes.title: Need Help?
nodes.summary: Customers can connect with the Zia AI assistant 24x7 in the ZX Bank Asia app or visit any branch for customized FD solutions.
